summary_md: **Nick ([@NMuldrow](https://x.com/NMuldrow/status/2115148547486298470))** shares **overseer**, a lightweight bridge for a plan-locally-execute split: Codex running a frontier model plans and audits, while the Pi agent running **Qwen 3.8 Flash Next on a DGX Spark** does the building. The GitHub repo describes frontier models orchestrating local coding workers across Codex, Pi, OMP and others.
